zh-CN.name: 缩放淡入
zh-CN.description: 结合缩放与透明度变化，适合少量新出现的内容。
use_when: 用于解释或比较与当前任务相关的设计选择。
avoid_when: 不要将演示参数当作通用行业标准。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 内容由 {scale_start} 倍缩放与透明状态变为原尺寸与不透明状态，持续 {duration_ms}ms，使用 {easing} 缓动。重播取消旧动画；减少动态效果时直接显示最终状态。

en.name: Scale and Fade
en.description: Combine scale and opacity for a small amount of newly appearing content.
use_when: Use to explain or compare design choices relevant to the current task.
avoid_when: Do not treat demo parameters as universal standards.
en.prompt_template: Animate from scale {scale_start} and opacity 0 to scale 1 and opacity 1 over {duration_ms}ms with {easing} easing. Cancel earlier animations on replay. Show the final state for reduced motion.

sources.note: 原创概念说明与演示；参数为本项目示例，非标准值。
概念或实现参考，未复制外部正文与组件代码。
